name: hud_layout_hw_on_activated
description: HudLayoutHW::OnActivated refreshes hardware HUD invalidation state, resets HUD element flags, rebuilds the stats triplet, applies sensor bounds, selects the active hardware widget images, and invalidates the widget2 viewport when HUD layouts are initialized.
known_limits: Tier C first; no VC verification target currently covers 0x413340, so tier S acceptance remains deferred to a HUD layout source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x413340 validate replicate-mode invalidation selection, global and layout child flag propagation, low-byte flag masking for widget3/objective/sensor/message widgets, stats-list triplet rebuild, sensor outer/inner bounds setup, hardware widget image selection by activeRect.right, SetImageBorrowedAndInvalidate calls for widget2 then widget1, and conditional widget2 InvalidateRect when HUD layouts are initialized.

Direct callees in the functional frontier are reconstructed, dependency-ready, implemented, and functionally accepted, including zOpt::GetReplicateMode, HudUi::SetInvalidateMode, HudUiContainer::SetChildFlags, HudUiTriplet::RebuildDisplay, HudSensorTracker::SetBounds, HudUiWidget::SetImageBorrowedAndInvalidate, and HudUiWidget::InvalidateRect.

The native hardware layout OnActivated smoke installs concrete HUD globals and triplet/layout/widget objects, calls OnActivated with replicate mode disabled and an 800-pixel active width, and verifies invalidation mask 0x0c, manager/layout child flags, masked global and message widget flags, scoreboard rebuild side effect, expanded sensor bounds, 320-width image selection, non-owned widget images, and widget2 dirty-rect invalidation from g_HudUiMgrViewRect.
